scenes.text: A translation slides every point the same distance and direction without turning or resizing the shape.
Translate point (-4, -2) by (4, 3). What is its new x-coordinate? The answer is 0. Add plus 4 to the original x-coordinate -4: new x is 0.
A point during a reading competition moves from (-1, -2) by -1 squares horizontally and -2 vertically. What is its new x-coordinate? Pause to choose and explain.
